citation: Székely, O., Holmes, N.P., et al. Development and Validation of the Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation Reporting Assessment Tool (TMS-RAT). bioRxiv 2026.02.18.706460
_note: Item ids, titles, descriptions and vocabularies are read from the official workbook and must not be edited here. Only 'source' and 'provider' are this tool's own classification.

items.title: Age
items.description: What age were the human and/or animal participants in the study?

items.title: Sex
items.description: What was the distribution of participant sex?

items.title: Handedness
items.description: What was the distribution of participant handedness?

items.title: Height
items.description: What were participants’ heights in cm or inches?

items.title: Weight
items.description: What were participants’ weights in kg or pounds?

items.title: Medication
items.description: Were participants screened for prescribed or unprescribed medications? (either specific medications, or more generally) If a medication is part of the study design (as an IV), were participants screened for other medications?

items.title: CNS-active substances
items.description: Were participants screened for CNS-active substances such as caffeine, alcohol, or nicotine? (either specific CNS-active substances, or more generally) If a CNS-active substance is part of the study design (as an IV), were participants screened for other substances?

items.title: Neurological, psychiatric or behavioural
items.description: Were participants screened for neurological, psychiatric, behavioural or developmental conditions? (either specific conditions, or more generally) If a condition is part of the study design (as an IV), were participants screened for other conditions?

items.title: Medical
items.description: Were participants screened for medical or systemic conditions? (either specific conditions, or more generally) If a condition is part of the study design (as an IV), were participants screened for other conditions?

items.title: Cognitive state
items.description: How was participants' current cognitive state assessed?

items.title: Sleep
items.description: How was participants' current alertness or recent sleep assessed?

items.title: Posture
items.description: What was the general body posture during the testing session? (e.g., standing, seated, lying?)

items.title: Studies
items.description: How many studies, experiments, or components are included in the article? How are participants divided between them?

items.title: Population
items.description: What population(s) of participants are studied?

items.title: Groups
items.description: How many independent groups were studied?

items.title: Protocol
items.description: What general TMS protocol was used?

items.title: Time of day
items.description: What time of day were the TMS sessions done?

items.title: Session duration and interval
items.description: For experimental sessions, what was the session duration? If the same participants completed multiple sessions, how were they scheduled?

items.title: Attention
items.description: How was participants’ attention maintained during the study, specifically during the TMS? (e.g., by task, breaks, monitoring by experimenter, or attention checks)

items.title: Control condition
items.description: Which procedures were used to control for non-specific, non-targeted or unwanted effects of TMS? Which control conditions, sham, placebo, or baseline comparisons were used?

items.title: Sensory attenuation
items.description: Which procedures were used to minimise side-effects of stimulation? (e.g., was there any anaesthesia, ear plugs, or other sensory attenuation?)

items.title: Stimulator
items.description: What make and model magnetic stimulator was used?

items.title: Coil shape and model
items.description: What was the shape of the TMS coil used and what was the model number?

items.title: Coil diameter
items.description: What was the diameter of the coil, or its wing(s), and what dimension does this diameter refer to?

items.title: Pulse waveform
items.description: What shape was the TMS pulse waveform?

items.title: Head and brain neuronavigation
items.description: Which method of head and/or brain neuronavigation was used, with details? With MRI-based methods, which scan type(s) were used and were they subject-specific or templates?

items.title: Coil location on skin
items.description: Where was the coil placed on the surface of the skin? What anatomical landmarks on the skin or bones were used, and what measurements were taken?

items.title: Target location in CNS
items.description: What was the anatomical (structural) or functional target within the nervous system? (within a few cm precision)

items.title: Coil orientation
items.description: How was the coil oriented relative to the head? Requires both the angle and what the angle is relative to - a reference point or plane

items.title: Coil current direction
items.description: What was the orientation of the current in the coil, relative to the target, and/or to the head or body?

items.title: Coil stability
items.description: How was the stability of the coil maintained (eg, by eye, mechanically, or with software)? Must be quantified using mm, cm, degrees, or another numerical measure

items.title: Intensity method
items.description: How was the TMS intensity decided?

items.title: Machine intensity
items.description: What was the intensity of the TMS used, in % of the maximum stimulator output (%MSO) or dI/dT?

items.title: Participant intensity
items.description: What was the participant-specific intensity of the TMS used, relative to a threshold? The threshold could be (e.g.) an MEP measure like RMT, AMT, 1mV, or 50% of the maximum MEP; an estimated induced current like V/m; or an estimated effect, eg 50% inhibition

items.title: Trial-to-trial interval
items.description: What was the duration between each successive test (unconditioned) pulse of TMS? Alternatively, what was the TMS frequency?

items.title: Number of pulses
items.description: How many single pulses of test (unconditioned) TMS were presented?

items.title: Evoked response raw
items.description: What are the values of responses evoked by test (unconditioned) pulses of TMS, in raw units? Most commonly: MEP amplitudes in mV or µV; could also be EMG area under curve or silent period duration; EEG responses; in conditioning protocols, the 'unconditioned' response

items.title: Threshold location
items.description: How was the scalp location used for the threshold located? Requires: a) distances relative to one or more scalp landmarks (vertex, inion, 10:20 electrode) OR b) Search strategy, which may involve a grid on the scalp or neuronavigation

items.title: Threshold type
items.description: What type of threshold was measured to determine stimulation intensity? Many motor thresholds will not involve EMG recording

items.title: Threshold criterion
items.description: What response was used to define the threshold?

items.title: Threshold algorithm
items.description: How was the TMS intensity adjusted to find the motor threshold?

items.title: Threshold values
items.description: What was the overall value of motor thresholds (e.g., RMT, AMT), in each participant group, expressed in %MSO or dI/dT?

items.title: Motor skills
items.description: Were participants screened for history of repetitive movements, skills, or expertise? (either specific skill/expertise, or more generally) If the skill/expertise is part of the study design (as an IV), were participants screened for other skills?

items.title: Prior motor activity
items.description: What were participants instructed to do, or reported doing, before the testing session?

items.title: Target muscle or body part activity
items.description: What was the level of activity in the targeted muscles or body parts during TMS? This refers to the principle time(s) or task(s) when the main dependent variable(s) were measured

items.title: EMG hardware
items.description: What make and model hardware was used to collect EMG data?

items.title: EMG software
items.description: What software and version were used to collect EMG data?

items.title: Skin preparation
items.description: How was the skin prepared?

items.title: Electrode type, material and size
items.description: What electrodes were used? (type, material and size)

items.title: Electrode location
items.description: Where were the electrodes placed? (targeted muscle and side of the body)

items.title: Electrode montage
items.description: What electrode placement was used? States the montage, and either the distance between electrodes or sufficient anatomical detail

items.title: Sampling and filtering
items.description: What sampling rate was used and what filtering was applied to the data at data acquisition? (sampling rate, filter type and cut-off frequencies)

items.title: EMG measure
items.description: What feature of the EMG data was measured, and within which specific time interval?

items.title: EMG amplitude normalization
items.description: For each participant, (target) muscle and session, how were the EMG responses normalised? (various approaches are possible: e.g., maximum voluntary contraction, MVC, maximal M-wave, MEP maximum, or not normalised: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jelekin.2020.102438)

items.title: Afferent stimulation hardware
items.description: What make and model peripheral nerve stimulator was used for afferent conditioning?

items.title: Electrodes or stimulators
items.description: What electrodes or other stimulators were used for afferent / peripheral skin or nerve stimulation, and how were they oriented on the body?

items.title: Afferent stimulus location
items.description: Where was the stimulator placed on the surface of the skin? What anatomical landmarks on the skin or bones were used?

items.title: Afferent stimulus target
items.description: What nerve was targeted?

items.title: Duration and waveform
items.description: How long was each nerve stimulus and what was the waveform?

items.title: Threshold type
items.description: What type of threshold was used to calibrate afferent stimulus intensity?

items.title: Threshold values
items.description: What was the threshold, in mA or V units?

items.title: Conditioning intensity (machine)
items.description: What was the intensity of the conditioning stimulus in raw units? For afferent conditioning this is in milliamps (mA) or volts (V) For TMS conditioning, this is in %MSO of dI/dT

items.title: Conditioning intensity (participant)
items.description: What was the participant-specific intensity of the conditioning stimulus, relative to a threshold? For afferent conditioning, the threshold could be a sensory/perceptual or motor measure such as visible twitch, M-wave, CMAP, or MMAX. For TMS conditioning, the threshold could be (e.g.) an MEP measure like RMT, AMT, 1mV, or 50% of maximum MEP; an estimated induced current like V/m; or estimated effect like 50% inhibition

items.title: Condition-Test interval(s)
items.description: When was the conditioning stimulus presented relative to the TMS pulse?

items.title: Conditioned and unconditioned order
items.description: Is the temporal order or arrangement of conditioned and unconditioned pulses clearly reported?

items.title: Number of conditioned TMS pulses
items.description: How many conditioned TMS pulses were given?

items.title: Conditioned response raw
items.description: What were the values of the conditioned responses, in raw units?

items.title: Conditioned response relative
items.description: What were the values of the conditioned responses, relative to the unconditioned responses?

items.title: Frequency and repetitions
items.description: What was the afferent stimulation frequency (or inter-pulse interval), and how many repetitions were done (or how long did the stimulation last)?

items.title: EEG montage
items.description: What arrangement of active and reference electrodes on the head and/or body was used to measure the SEPs?

items.title: SEP feature
items.description: Which SEP potential, component, or feature was targeted? Must refer to the component name and whether it's an amplitude of timing feature

items.title: SEP values
items.description: What were the values of the SEP measure?

items.title: Burst frequency
items.description: What was the frequency (or inter-pulse interval) within a single burst of rTMS?

items.title: Number of within-burst pulses
items.description: How many consecutive pulses were within each burst of rTMS (or how long did the rTMS last)?
full_requires: pulses per burst or total duration

items.title: Between-burst interval
items.description: What was the interval (or frequency) between consecutive bursts of rTMS?

items.title: Number of bursts
items.description: How many bursts of rTMS were presented (or how long did the rTMS last)?

items.title: Between-train interval
items.description: What was the between-train interval (or frequency)?

items.title: Number of trains
items.description: How many trains of rTMS were given?

items.title: Interval between TMS and task or measure
items.description: What was the duration between the end of TMS and the start of the task or measurement?

items.title: Number of repeats
items.description: How many times was the rTMS protocol described in sections M1:M7 repeated?
